title: 第17章 秘境三足鼎立第18章 三方决定林家商议
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 只见随着那玉简的破碎，一道虚幻的身影陡然出现于这片虚空，紧接着一股强大的气势迸发而出。
原本还一脸从容的另外两支队伍，瞬间被压得跪伏在空中，哪怕是那两位领头的尊者境九重天的修士，同样如此。
那股气势压得他们根本喘不过气来，一股如临深渊般的寒意感涌上心头，令他们的身体都不由自主的颤抖起来。
一道虚影便有如此恐怖，来人的实力可见一斑……
对于在场的众人来说，他们以往引以为傲的王者境实力尊者境实力，在这等恐怖如斯的力量面前，简直弱的可怜，根本不是一个层次的！
他们毫不怀疑这道虚影，只需动动手指便可让他们形神俱灭，身死道消！
而在那两方人马被死死的压在空中时，那捏碎玉简的队伍，也是恭敬行礼道：
“拜见族长！”
“呃……所为何事？可是遇到了解决不了之事？”
只见那道霸气的虚影点了点头，旋即询问起来，那犹如深渊般眼神也缓缓的望向了那两支队伍。
意思不言而喻。
蔡家、白家之人吗……
而就是这平静的一眼，却是让那两支队伍的人，仿佛犹如在地狱走了一遭般，瞬间惊恐万分，冷汗直流。
完了！
这回死定了……
至于那道虚影，不是别人，正是林天海！
而这虚影，便是他封存于玉简中的一缕神识所化，关键时刻足以爆发出圣人境的实力，事后他本体也会第一时间得知所有的事情，乃是他给予这支小队的底牌。
而就在两支队伍之人，以为他们就要命丧黄泉时，两道阴冷的声音传出，瞬间让他们身体一轻，重新拿回了身体的“控制权”。
总算是逃过一劫……
“堂堂林家族长，欺负一群小辈，也不怕让天下人耻笑！”
“哼！林天海，你这是欺我白家无人吗？”
随着两道阴冷的话音落下，两道同样散发着恐怖气势的虚影，瞬间出现在空中，与林天海的虚影呈三角之势，眼神冰冷无比的望着他。
而林天海对于来人自然再熟悉不过，正是蔡家和白家的族长……
蔡家族长，蔡基！
白家族长，白池！
原来在看到林天海虚影的第一时间，蔡家和白家两个队伍的领头人，便知道接下来的事不是他们能处理的了，为了他们自己的小命，于是毫不犹豫的拿出了各自的底牌。
这才有了眼前这一幕的发生。
“本族长可什么都没干，是他们自己要跪下向本族长行礼的。”
“菜鸡、白痴，你们可别平白污了本族长的名声。”
“否则小心老子削你们啊！”
只见林天海丝毫没有将他们的话放在心上，只是一脸从容道。
闻言，两家族长立马异口同声的就要怼回去，可是一时间又不知道怼啥。
不对
他们咋有种被林天海羞辱了的感觉？
可是具体哪里不对……
最后两人只能脸色铁青的就着林天海最后一句话，冷哼道：
“哼，林天海你真以为我们怕你！”
“真要打，谁削谁还不一定呢！”
content_en:
As the jade slip was shattered, an illusory figure suddenly appeared in the void, followed by a powerful aura bursting out.
The other two teams, which were originally calm, were instantly suppressed and fell to their knees in the air, even the two leading monks who were at the ninth level of the Venerable Realm were the same.
The momentum was so overwhelming that they couldn't breathe at all, and a cold feeling as if they were facing an abyss surged into their hearts, making their bodies tremble involuntarily.
A shadow can be so terrifying, which shows the strength of the person coming...
For everyone present, the king-level and venerable-level strength that they were proud of in the past was pitifully weak in the face of such terrifying power. It was not on the same level at all!
They have no doubt that this phantom can destroy them physically and mentally with just a move of their fingers!
When the two groups of men and horses were pressed tightly in the air, the team that crushed the jade slips also saluted respectfully:
"Meet the clan leader!"
…
"Uh...what's the matter? But you encountered something that you can't solve?"
The domineering shadow nodded, and immediately asked, its abyss-like eyes slowly looking at the two teams.
The meaning is self-evident.
Are you from the Cai family or the Bai family...
But just this calm glance made the people in the two teams feel as if they had been through hell. They were instantly frightened and broke out in cold sweat.
It’s over!
This time it's dead...
As for that phantom, it was none other than Lin Tianhai!
And this phantom is a ray of consciousness that he sealed in the jade slip. It is enough to burst out the strength of the saint at the critical moment. Afterwards, his body will know everything immediately. It is the trump card he gave to this team.
And just when the two teams thought they were about to die, two cold voices came out, instantly making their bodies lighten and regaining "control" of their bodies.
Finally escaped...
"The dignified head of the Lin family is not afraid of making the world laugh at him even if he bullies a group of juniors!"
"Hmph! Lin Tianhai, are you deceiving me that there is no one in the Bai family?"
As the two cold words fell, two phantoms that also exuded a terrifying aura instantly appeared in the air, forming a triangle with Lin Tianhai's phantom, looking at him with extremely cold eyes.
And Lin Tianhai was naturally very familiar with the person coming. He was the patriarch of the Cai family and the Bai family...
The head of the Cai family, Cai Ji!
The head of the Bai family, Bai Chi!
It turned out that the first time they saw Lin Tianhai's shadow, the leaders of the Cai family and the Bai family knew that what happened next was beyond their control. For the sake of their own lives, they did not hesitate to use their respective trump cards.
Only then did the scene in front of him happen.
"My clan leader didn't do anything. They had to kneel down and salute my clan leader."
"Rookies and idiots, please don't ruin the reputation of this clan leader."
"Otherwise, be careful, I will cut you off!"
I saw that Lin Tianhai didn't take their words to heart at all, he just said calmly.
"You..."
Hearing this, the heads of the two families immediately said in unison that they wanted to fight back, but for a while they didn't know what to fight against.
Wrong
Why do they feel like they were humiliated by Lin Tianhai?
But what exactly is wrong...
In the end, the two of them could only look at Lin Tianhai's last words with pale faces and snorted coldly:
"Hmph, Lin Tianhai, you really think we are afraid of you!"
"If we really want to fight, we don't know who will cut who!"
title_en: Chapter 17 The three-legged confrontation in the secret realm Chapter 18 The three parties decided to discuss with the Lin family
